oldBody: Mow tops, narrow rows to 12 in, fertilize, irrigate. Within 1 wk of last harvest.
newBody: Within 1 week of the last harvest, mow off the leaves; then narrow the rows, fertilize and irrigate.

oldBody: 3 in straw after 2–3 hard frosts but before sustained cold.
newBody: Spread straw over the plants after the first freezing weather in fall, before sustained cold.

oldBody: Open blossoms freeze at 30 °F; row cover + irrigation can save a crop.
newBody: Open blossoms are damaged at 30 °F. Cover rows on frost nights. Overhead irrigation protects only while water runs continuously until temperatures rise above freezing; stopping too early can do more damage than not irrigating.

oldBody: Single-crop management: cut all canes 1 in tall after dormancy; new canes will fruit Aug-Oct.
newBody: Single-crop management: cut all canes to the ground after dormancy; new canes will fruit Aug-Oct.

oldBody: Pick every 2–3 d. Cool berries to 32–34 °F within 1 h.
newBody: Pick ripe berries often. Cool the fruit as soon as possible after harvest.

oldBody: Encourages lateral branching for next year's crop.
newBody: Encourages lateral branching for next year's crop.

oldBody: Mid-Oct → mid-Nov. Mulch 4–6 in straw after planting.
newBody: Mid-Oct → mid-Nov. Mulch with a thick layer of straw after planting.

oldBody: Remove 1/6 oldest canes; thin twiggy growth. Aim for 6–8 productive canes per mature bush.
newBody: Prune out one of every six existing canes, oldest first, close to the ground; thin twiggy growth. A mature bush should have 10 to 15 canes.

oldBody: Pick every 5–7 d; berries fully blue + drop into hand without pull.
newBody: Pick every five to seven days, more often if birds are a problem; berries fully blue + drop into hand without pull.

oldBody: Cane prune to 4-arm Kniffin or umbrella Kniffin. 80% of last year's wood removed.
newBody: Cane prune to four-arm Kniffin or umbrella Kniffin. Remove most of last year's wood.

oldBody: Remove non-count shoots and weak shoots from cordon to balance crop.
newBody: Remove non-count shoots and weak shoots from cordon to balance crop.

oldBody: Brix ≥ 16 + characteristic foxy aroma. Single-pass mechanical or hand.
newBody: At least 16° Brix (the juice processor minimum) + characteristic foxy aroma. Single-pass mechanical or hand.
Pick by the harvest cues in this crop's Care Guide.
